messages:
priya: Heads up  were seeing intermittent model-binding failures for llama3q-large when clients using SDK 3.0 attempt to enable kernel-accelerated attention. Failures manifest as p99 timeouts + some 5xxs in eu-central. Suggest a temporary SDK compatibility pin/advisory rather than rolling back runtime globally.

ken: Can we scope advisory to SDK clients only? We should avoid touching customer infra unless necessary. If the root cause is a client-side flag that flips kernel path, a client pin makes sense.

deploybot: Automated: compatibility advisory posted -> target=sdk:3.0, issue=kernel-accel-bind-failure, id=adv-1815007777, started=2026-03-24T10:12Z. Note: advisory blocks auto-upgrade flows and surfaces in the console for affected orgs.

support: Affected tenants list attached to ticket INC-4492. We can send targeted in-app messages once eng-platform drafts the advisory text.

priya: Proposed steps: 1) publish SDK advisory to prevent auto-upgrade to 3.0 in eu-central; 2) ask customers to downgrade to SDK 2.9 or enable runtime-fallback flag; 3) coordinate with runtime team on a hotfix for the kernel binding in v4.1.

eng-platform: Drafted advisory + release note entry: "SDK 3.0 compatibility hold in eu-central for kernel-accelerated attention due to intermittent binding errors with runtime v4.1. Workarounds: downgrade to SDK 2.9 or set client flag `use_kernel_accel=false`. We will lift the hold after runtime patch v4.1.1 or SDK 3.0.1 is released and validated in canary."

oncall-bot: Alert: spike in model_bind_failures (p95) -> 2.7% in eu-central. Monitoring for 15m.

ken: Also adding a temporary tenant routing rule for the largest affected customer to route them to the non-accelerated model variant while we fix. That should keep their SLA intact.

deploybot: Routing change applied -> region=eu-central model=llama3q-large split={primary:85, non_accel:15}, id=route-1815007777. Manual unpin/unblock requires eng-releases approver.

priya: OK, locking advisory and routing in place. Runtime fix ETA from infra is ~3 hours. Once we have a runtime patch and one healthy canary cycle, eng-platform will publish the lift note and deploybot will clear the advisory.

eng-platform: Release notes entry saved. Support templates updated. I'll ping #sales for any impacted accounts.

priya: Leaving advisory active until v4.1.1 is validated. Will update thread when we unfreeze. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
